resources.string: Lets your WitBox bots operate this device, only with your permission.

Lets the bots on your own WitBox server control this device: capture the screen, tap, swipe, type text, press Back/Home and open apps.\n\nNothing happens without your consent: each bot is set to Never, Ask or Always inside the WitBox app (default: Never). While a bot is in control a notification with a Stop button is shown. Screen contents are sent only to the WitBox server you configured.
Is Tailscale connected?\nThe server at %1$s did not respond.
WitBox runs on your own server and is reachable only over your Tailscale network. Enter your server\'s address: https:// with the MagicDNS name, or http:// with a 100.x.y.z tailnet IP.
